source_note: Primary sources are official Orange County Notices of Commencement and other public records. News articles are secondary references only.

permits.title: Disney Springs – Footbridge (Marketplace–Town Center) (Buena Vista Construction / Facilities Asset Management)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed September 22, 2026, by Facilities Asset Management (FAM) with contractor Buena Vista Construction Company for “General Construction” at 1620 East Buena Vista Drive (Disney Springs footbridge connecting Marketplace and Town Center over the lagoon). Standard one-year term expiring September 21, 2027. FAM/BVCC filings typically indicate maintenance or general construction rather than major themed work. No official closure announced; work could require temporary bridge closure. Official Orange County document referenced by sources. Source: WDWNT; Inside the Magic.
permits.location: Disney Springs – Footbridge (1620 East Buena Vista Drive)
permits.source_name: WDWNT; corroborated by Inside the Magic

permits.title: Magic Kingdom – Piston Peak / Near Haunted Mansion (PCL Construction / Walt Disney Imagineering)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement filed by Walt Disney Imagineering for PCL Construction Services Inc. to perform “General Construction” at 1610 Magic Kingdom Dr, an address not previously listed in the county database (nearest known address is Haunted Mansion at 1600 Magic Kingdom Dr). The new address indicates a ground-up structure rather than work on an existing building. Location aligns with a cleared area of treeline next to Haunted Mansion visible in recent aerials and the Piston Peak scale model shown at D23, which included a building with restroom signage in that spot. Part of ongoing Piston Peak National Park (Cars-themed land) construction. Official Orange County document referenced by source. Source: WDWMAGIC.
permits.location: Magic Kingdom – Piston Peak / adjacent to Haunted Mansion (1610 Magic Kingdom Dr)

permits.title: EPCOT – Norway Pavilion (Buena Vista Construction)
permits.description: Notice of Commencement recorded September 21, 2026, for Buena Vista Construction Company to “Provide labor, material and/or electrical for construction” at 1600 Avenue of the Stars (main building, Norway Pavilion). Standard one-year term. No specific attraction, restaurant, or shop named. BVCC filings typically indicate maintenance, refurbishment, or infrastructure work rather than major themed or creative projects. No indication of impact to Frozen Ever After or other venues. Official Orange County document referenced by source. Source: WDWNT.
